title: Task Kanban
description: Kanban orchestration for v2 multi-agent task trees, with root/subtask flow, approvals, Artifact and Workspace review.
emptyColumn: No tasks. Drag cards here to trigger the matching status action.
defaultFailReason: Manually terminated from the admin Kanban board

bulkDelete.columnHint: Uses the same bulk hard-delete API as the top-right action, scoped to this column's statuses and the current page filters.
bulkDelete.title: Bulk Hard Delete Tasks
bulkDelete.description: Choose which task category to delete. The current filters are used for preview, then a second confirmation is required.
bulkDelete.secondDescription: About to delete around {roots} task trees in "{category}".
bulkDelete.irreversible: This is irreversible and removes database records, logs, artifacts and workspace files.
bulkDelete.preview: Estimated impact: {roots} task trees, {cards} visible board cards, including {subtasks} subtask cards.
bulkDelete.noExtraFilters: No scope, bot, group or owner filters are set; deletion will be limited by category status only.

confirm.pause: Pause "{name}"? It will move to the blocked column until resumed.
confirm.resume: Resume "{name}"? This will kick the root scheduler once.
confirm.respawn: Respawn "{name}"? After the third respawn the backend may force approval.
confirm.failRoot: Fail the whole task tree "{name}"? This is irreversible and cascades unfinished subtasks.
confirm.failSubtask: Fail subtask "{name}"? The root task will not be cascaded automatically.
confirm.hardDelete: Hard delete task tree "{name}"? This is irreversible and will permanently remove database records, logs, artifacts and workspace files.
confirm.deleteArtifact: Delete Artifact {id}? Linked payload files will also be removed.

detail.title: Task Details
detail.description: Inspect task tree, event logs, artifacts and workspace files.
detail.selectTask: Select a task card to view details

workspace.title: Workspace Files
workspace.patchWarning: Patch submissions are registered as artifacts for human review and are never applied automatically. workspace_violation logs indicate attempted out-of-bound writes.

create.title: Create Task Tree
create.description: Direct admin creation for demos/debugging; production flows should evaluate capabilities first.
create.guideGoal: Start with a clear, verifiable final goal.
create.guideSubtasks: Split it into one or more subtasks and assign an agent profile to each.
create.guideDepends: Use dependency indexes for ordering, for example 0,1.
create.goalPlaceholder: Example: collect weekly trends every day, summarize them and create a report poster
create.subtasksHint: Each card should describe one independently executable step.
create.subtaskCardHint: Describe the output and choose the best execution agent.
create.subtaskPlaceholder: Example: search hot topics from the last 24 hours and output a structured summary

evaluate.title: Test Capability Coverage
evaluate.description: Run capability_evaluator to check coverage and generate suggested subtasks.
evaluate.goalPlaceholder: Example: collect weekly trends and generate a report poster every day

patch.title: Submit Patch Artifact
patch.description: The patch will be stored in Artifact Hub for human review and will not be applied automatically.

messages.doneDropUnsupported: The Done column is controlled by backend execution results.
messages.createValidation: Fill the goal, persona and at least one subtask with description and agent profile.
messages.createSuccess: Task tree created and scheduling kicked
messages.fileTooLarge: Recommended upload size is no more than 20MB.

stateStore.title: Persistent State Browser
stateStore.selectScopeHint: Select a scope first to view its persistent state keys.
stateStore.deleteDescription: About to delete key "{key}" under scope "{scope}". Agent personas may depend on this state for business logic; deletion may cause re-initialization or errors.
stateStore.deleteWarning: Deletion is irreversible. Please confirm this state is indeed stale or obsolete.

batchDelete.title: Confirm Batch Delete State Entries
batchDelete.description: About to delete {count} state entries under scope "{scope}". Agent personas may depend on these states; deletion may cause re-initialization or errors.
batchDelete.warning: Batch deletion is irreversible. Please review each entry before confirming.

messages.batchDeleteSuccess: Batch delete completed: {deleted} deleted, {notFound} not found

preview.unsupported: Preview is not supported for this file type
